Your responsibilities:

• Support and replace the team leader in daily operations

Do you recognize yourself in the items listed below:

Inetum is a European leader supporting organizations as they navigate continuous technological change.

With deep industry expertise, a strong innovation culture, and a scalable international model, we help clients transform their operations and generate sustainable impact across business and society.

Guided by European values, we empower local businesses to create positive impact and unlock society's full potential. Job description

You will contribute to innovative software projects involving Java development, cloud-native applications, DevOps practices, software architecture, and digital transformation initiatives. Whether you are a senior developer, an architect, or a technical lead specialist, we would love to hear from you.
Project opportunities

Assignments may include:

• Java Development

• Senior Java Development

• DevOps Engineering

• Solution Architecture

• Software Architecture

Interested?

• TerraForm

• Docker

As an Operations Manager at Skechers, you report directly to the Director of Operations and independently manage several departments. 

Your key responsibilities include:
  
• Planning, organizing, and supervising daily operations to meet short- and long-term goals, while ensuring budget, deadlines, and safety standards are met in an automated environment. 
• Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture. 
• Developing strategic business plans for the short, medium, and long term for your departments. 
• Taking necessary actions to achieve performance objectives by defining and monitoring team KPIs, while effectively managing operational costs. 
• Leading, coaching, evaluating, and developing your teams (approx. 150 people) in collaboration with Team Leaders and Leads. Communication is central to your role—both with your teams and social partners. 
• Managing and optimizing automated processes with a continuous improvement mindset.  
This role requires adaptability, versatility, and a proactive approach to overcoming daily challenges and driving operational excellence.

Education and technical skills: 
 
• Minimum 3 years of proven experience in a similar role within an automated/production environment. 
• Proficiency in WMS, WCS, and AS400 systems. 
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook). 
• Strong working knowledge of English.  
Your personality and soft skills:
  
• Leadership – You are a driver of change and adapt easily to a constantly evolving environment. 
• Communication – You adjust your communication to suit your audience and actively listen. 
• Customer & results orientation – You go the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction. 
• Stress management – You remain positive and composed when facing day-to-day challenges. 
• Conflict resolution & negotiation – You are assertive and diplomatic when managing tensions. 
• Attention to detail – You are uncompromising when it comes to safety and adherence to procedures and workplace rules.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk. 

User support
  
• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site 
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals 
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support 
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN) 
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)  
Access and security
  
• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures 
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)  
Hardware and lifecycle
  
• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals) 
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights) 
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals 
• Tickets, escalation and coordination 
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…) 
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs 
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers 
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions 
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)  
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.
 
THE TEAM & THE MANAGER
 
Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential 
 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT 
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support 
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written 
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA 
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity  
Assets
  
• Knowledge of Arabic 
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer 
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment 
• IT certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)  
Soft skills
  
• Customer focus and service mindset 
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management 
• Clear communication with non-technical users 
• Hands-on, proactive attitude

You know payroll. Now imagine what else you could do.

You've gained a solid foundation in Belgian payroll and HR administration. You enjoy getting the details right, solving practical problems and helping colleagues. But perhaps you're ready to go beyond payroll: more employee interaction, more variety and the opportunity to contribute to broader HR projects.

Our client, an established international professional services organisation with a multicultural Brussels office, is looking for a hands-on HR Coordinator. This is an opportunity to use your payroll expertise from day one while gradually expanding your role across the employee lifecycle

Jobomschrijving

Your role: payroll expertise with room to grow

Own the payroll essentials

• Coordinate Belgian payroll administration for approximately 30 employees, working with external payroll partners and ensuring timely, accurate input and follow-up.
• Manage employee records, contracts, absences, benefits and personnel changes.
• Act as a first point of contact for payroll and day-to-day HR questions.
• Help maintain accurate HR reporting and compliance with Belgian employment requirements.
Become involved in broader HR

• Coordinate onboarding and offboarding, ensuring new colleagues feel welcome and supported.
• Contribute to employee benefits, mobility and cafeteria plan initiatives.
• Help improve HR processes, procedures and employee-facing information.
• Support recruitment coordination, training, engagement and other HR projects.
You'll be trusted to take ownership of your work, while collaborating closely with experienced HR colleagues. The aim is to give you meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to keep learning—not to expect you to know every aspect of HR already.

Is this your next step?

• Around three years or more of relevant experience in Belgian payroll and HR administration, including benefits.
• Enough practical payroll knowledge to take ownership of day-to-day coordination quickly; SD Worx experience is a strong advantage.
• Good knowledge of Belgian employment administration, confidence with Excel and an interest in HR systems.
• Excellent English, Dutch at minimum B2 level with a B1 in French. French-speaking candidates with B2 Dutch and excellent English are equally welcome.
• An organised, accurate, proactive and service-minded approach; you enjoy helping people and taking initiative.
• A genuine interest in broadening your HR experience and building a lasting role in a collaborative team.
A background in a law firm or consultancy, or a specific HR degree, is welcome but not required.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 

• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities.

• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.

Your role and responsibilities;

• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards.
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products.
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment.
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity.

This role is suited for you if you:

• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.

What your day-to-day will look like:

• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
• Supporting transitions between production zones
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do

• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.
Good to KnowYou’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives.

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 

Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, …) in a controlled temperature environment.

Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.

Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic

Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.

Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.

Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site.  

Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.

Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.

Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.

At Legend Biotech in Zwijnaarde, you will have the opportunity to participate in the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies, an innovative form of cancer treatment. You will work in a highly technological GMP-regulated environment.

• Working daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment
• Ensuring the cleanliness of equipment and production areas
Performing various steps within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including:

• Cell isolation
• Cell selection, activation, and transduction
• Cell culture
• Aseptic processing
• Filling and finishing operations
• Cryopreservation
Manufacturing clinical and commercial ATMPs (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products)

• Adhering to all applicable quality and safety standards
Performing in-process controls on batch samples while maintaining the highest quality standards

Strictly following SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), batch records, and GMP guidelines

• Recording and managing GMP documentation to ensure compliance and traceability
Supporting environmental monitoring and the maintenance of GMP production areas

• Experience in a GMP environment and/or ATMP manufacturing is a strong asset

If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. 

What you can expect: 

• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
